title: Your Phone Is Filthier Than You Think. Here's the Right Way to Clean It - CNET
summary: Lens cleaning wipes are great for cleaning your phone’s screen. To disinfect your phone, Apple, Google and Samsung all recommend using 70% isopropyl alcohol-based cleaning wipes.
